headline: A narrow 11-pack day: QRadar rewritten, Microsoft Entra ID nearly doubles in additions
summary_md:
- Only 11 packs move for 5 upstream commits — +2,128/-239 — a quarter of the previous day's pack count.
- **QRadar** (+1,080/-184) and **MicrosoftEntraID** (+774/-1) are 87% of the day's insertions between them; everything else is small.
- QRadar carries nearly all the day's deletions, so that pack was rewritten rather than extended; Entra ID is near-pure addition.
- Two Slack commits land together: telemetry-failure list messages and an `auth_target` mapping for event 102.
- The `identity.*` modeling-rule work continues at PR 2 of 7 (CRTX-271527, #45464), a day after PR 1.

highlights.title: QRadar is the day's dominant change at +1,080/-184
highlights.detail: The pack holds 76% of the day's deletions against 51% of its insertions, so existing code was replaced; the commit subject is only "Qradar" (#45622) and says no more.

highlights.title: Microsoft Entra ID gains 774 lines against a single deletion
highlights.detail: The day's largest near-pure addition, and the snapshot names no commit subject for it.

highlights.title: identity.* fields reach modeling rules PR 2 of 7
highlights.detail: CRTX-271527 (#45464) continues the seven-part ingestion-mapping series that opened the day before; the snapshot does not say which pack carried it.

highlights.title: Slack moves twice — telemetry failure messages and an event 102 auth_target mapping
highlights.detail: CRTX-275112 (#45629) and CRTX-274913 (#45648) together account for the pack's +40/-15.

highlights.title: Four unrelated packs move by an identical +9/-2
highlights.detail: Active Directory Query, Core, Filters And Transformers and Smokescreen IllusionBLACK change by the same amount, the signature of one shared edit applied across packs.

highlights.title: A script migration is the day's snapshot head
highlights.detail: CRTX-265664 (#45511) is the newest commit in the day's window; CommonScripts (+69/-11) and Base (+14/-3) are the largest of the remaining pack moves.

items.Packs/QRadar: +1,080/-184, the day's largest pack change and the source of most of its deletions (#45622).
items.Packs/MicrosoftEntraID: +774/-1, the day's largest near-pure addition; unattributed in the day's commit subjects.
items.Packs/CommonScripts: +69/-11, unattributed by subject on a day whose head commit is a script migration (#45511).
items.Packs/CloudIncidentResponse: +59/-16, the third-highest deletion count of the day and unattributed in the commit subjects.
items.Packs/Tableau: +56/-1, near-pure addition with no commit subject naming it.
items.Packs/Slack: +40/-15 across two commits: telemetry failure list messages (CRTX-275112, #45629) and an auth_target mapping for event 102 (CRTX-274913, #45648).
items.Packs/Base: +14/-3, unattributed in the day's commit subjects.
items.Packs/Active_Directory_Query: +9/-2, one of four packs moving by an identical amount.
items.Packs/Core: +9/-2, one of four packs moving by an identical amount.
items.Packs/FiltersAndTransformers: +9/-2, one of four packs moving by an identical amount.
items.Packs/Smokescreen_IllusionBLACK: +9/-2, one of four packs moving by an identical amount.
